case_pc_fsin_c2.emulator_gap: Unicorn leaves C1 clear after fsin; a real x87 sets it when the result was rounded up (Intel SDM, FSIN: C1 "set if result was rounded up")

case_pc_sbb_idiom.known: cmp does not publish CF, so sbb reads the running _cf. Making it precise deterministically broke Fury3; see the note on sbb in lift32.py.

case_pc_span_carry_default.known: adc/sbb read the _cf variable, which add/sub/cmp do not write; Lifter(precise_carry=True) derives it (off by default: Fury3)
